purpose: Soft reconstruction priors, not a room template or building-code certification.
precedence: regional product examples and design guidance

bed_layout.scope: Bedroom layouts vary with shape, access and individual needs; a bed can be in front of a window.

mattresses_uk.scope: UK mattress examples, not bed-frame outer dimensions or universal sizes.

desk_ergonomics.scope: Provide working and leg clearance; this does not determine the position of desks in a photograph.

kitchen_workflow.scope: Multiple layouts are valid; sink, stove and refrigerator relationships guide planning, not reconstruction relocation.

accessible_route_us.scope: US ADA accessible routes; exceptions and applicability matter. Not an Indian building-code assertion or a room-sizing prior.

desk_monitor_viewing_distance_m.use: ergonomic context only; not desk depth

accessible_route_general_width_m.use: optional US accessibility review only; never automatically enlarge observed aisles

scene_rules: There is no fixed bed-to-window ratio or mandatory window wall. Preserve visible openings, including asymmetric layouts.
Do not infer room dimensions from a single assumed standard bed. Mattress sizes vary by region and frame dimensions are larger.
Reconstruct the existing space, not an ideal redesigned room. Do not add missing furniture from a room category.
Preserve separate freestanding units. Join built-in furniture only when image edges and a common supporting wall corroborate contact.
Distinguish floor-supported, wall-mounted, ceiling-mounted and tabletop-supported objects. Preserve visible air gaps.
Desk, dining and kitchen clearances are useful ambiguity checks, not permission to move observed objects or claim compliance.
Hall, office, retail and unknown spaces must not acquire bedroom furniture or bedroom proportions.
